versions.changelog:
Version 1.1.0 — Expanded CMS/platform support and documentation polish.

- Skill is now platform-agnostic: suitable for any CMS (Ghost, WordPress, Webflow, Sanity) or static-site generator.
- Documentation rewritten for broader, non-Ghost use—notes Ghost-specific integration as just one example.
- Homepage and project links updated; references to AutomateLab-tech.
- Improved description clarifying use cases, editorial figure rules, and output workflow.
- Removed skill-card.md (no longer needed).

Initial publish: generates accessible SVG figures (flow, compare, taxonomy, terminal, feature card) for blog posts. Hand-authored SVG with title/desc accessibility, system-font palette, rasterizes to compressed PNG.
